official: 官方在线 2026-09-15 · 来源：RSS
abstract: La baisse de la consommation d'actualités chez les jeunes est-elle inévitable ? Cet article rend compte d’un essai contrôlé randomisé à grande échelle mené en France afin de vérifier si l’accès gratuit à un grand quotidien et la formation des enseignants à l’éducation aux médias peuvent stimuler la lecture de la presse écrite chez les lycéens. L’accès gratuit au Monde a entraîné une augmentation durable de la consommation d’actualités et une forte amélioration des connaissances en matière d’actualité, en particulier chez les élèves inscrits dans des lycées défavorisés, ce qui suggère que l’accès à des informations de qualité et à une éducation aux médias peut contribuer à réduire les inégalités socio-économiques en matière de connaissances sur l’actualité.

title: DP13993 The Brexit Vote, Productivity Growth and Macroeconomic Adjustments in the United Kingdom
title_zh: 英国脱欧公投、生产率增长与宏观经济调整
title_primary: 英国脱欧公投、生产率增长与宏观经济调整
title_secondary: DP13993 The Brexit Vote, Productivity Growth and Macroeconomic Adjustments in the United Kingdom
authors: Ben Broadbent, Federico Di Pace, Thomas Drechsel, Richard Harrison, Silvana Tenreyro
official: 官方在线 2019-09-13 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: The UK economy has experienced significant macroeconomic adjustments following the 2016 referendum on its withdrawal from the European Union. This paper develops and estimates a small open economy model with tradable and non-tradable sectors to characterize these adjustments. We demonstrate that many of the effects of the referendum result can be conceptualized as news about a future slowdown in productivity growth in the tradable sector. Simulations show that the responses of the model economy to such news are consistent with key patterns in UK data. While overall economic growth slows, an immediate permanent fall in the relative price of non-tradable output (the real exchange rate) induces a temporary “sweet spot” for tradable producers before the slowdown in the tradable sector productivity associated with Brexit occurs. Resources are reallocated towards the tradable sector, tradable output growth rises and net exports increase. These developments reverse after the productivity decline in the tradable sector materializes. The negative news about tradable sector productivity also lead to a decline in domestic interest rates relative to world interest rates and to a reduction in investment growth, while employment remains relatively stable. As a by-product of our Brexit simulations, we provide a quantitative analysis of the UK business cycle.
abstract_zh: 英国经济在2016年脱欧公投后经历了显著的宏观经济调整。本文构建并估计了一个包含可贸易品部门与不可贸易品部门的小型开放经济模型，以刻画这些调整。我们表明，公投结果的许多影响可以被理解为关于可贸易品部门未来生产率增长放缓的消息。模拟显示，模型经济对此类消息的响应与英国数据中的关键模式相一致。尽管整体经济增长放缓，但不可贸易品产出的相对价格（实际汇率）立即永久性下降，这在与英国脱欧相关的可贸易品部门生产率放缓发生之前，为可贸易品生产商创造了一个暂时的“甜蜜点”。资源被重新配置到可贸易品部门，可贸易品产出增长上升，净出口增加。这些变化在可贸易品部门生产率下降成为现实之后发生逆转。关于可贸易品部门生产率的负面消息还导致国内利率相对于世界利率下降，以及投资增长放缓，而就业则保持相对稳定。作为我们脱欧模拟的一个副产品，我们提供了对英国经济周期的定量分析。

authors: Annie Soyean Lee, Steve Pak Yeung Wu
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-02 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The surge in foreign currency (FC) corporate debt in emerging economies has sparked concerns about macroeconomic stability, heightened by speculation about nonfinancial firms engaging in carry trades. Using firm-level data on the currency denomination of both assets and liabilities, we find evidence of firms’ carry trades: firms save in local currency liquid assets and earn higher interest income after issuing short-term FC debt. They also set aside FC liquid assets as FX risk buffers. A large degree of heterogeneity in incentives is observed. Notably, listed firms participate more in carry trades and allocate fewer FX risk buffers than nonlisted firms.

title: Recall Fluency, Beliefs and Behavior
title_zh: 记忆流畅性、信念与行为
title_primary: 记忆流畅性、信念与行为
title_secondary: Recall Fluency, Beliefs and Behavior
authors: Pedro Bordalo, Nicola Gennaioli, Matthew O'Brien, Andrei Shleifer
official: 官方在线 2026-08-17 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: The US Health and Retirement Study collects data on participants’ recall fluency (RF), their ability to recall words from a list, a standard measure of memory used by psychologists. Controlling for multiple demographic characteristics as well as IQ, people with a higher RF are more optimistic about stock returns, the price of their homes, and their life expectancy. We derive the predictions of a standard memory model and find that, consistent with them, the beliefs of higher RF people about each target domain are more sensitive to cues, to experiences in that domain, but also to irrelevant experiences in other domains, especially those similar to the target. These effects, in turn, carry to investment and retirement choices. RF emerges as an economically relevant personal trait.
abstract_zh: 美国健康与退休研究收集了参与者的回忆流畅度（RF）数据，即他们从列表中回忆单词的能力，这是心理学家使用的标准记忆测量指标。在控制多种人口统计学特征及智商后，RF较高的人对股票回报、房产价格及自身寿命预期更为乐观。我们推导了一个标准记忆模型的预测，并发现与这些预测一致，RF较高的人对每个目标领域的信念对线索、该领域的经历，乃至其他领域不相关经历（尤其是与目标相似的经历）更为敏感。这些效应进而传导至投资和退休决策。RF因此显现为一项具有经济意义的个人特质。

title: Unfree Wills: Inheritance Rules, Bequest Motives, and Wealth Diffusion
title_zh: 不自由的遗嘱：继承规则、遗赠动机与财富扩散
title_primary: 不自由的遗嘱：继承规则、遗赠动机与财富扩散
title_secondary: Unfree Wills: Inheritance Rules, Bequest Motives, and Wealth Diffusion
authors: Marius Brülhart
official: 官方在线 2026-08-03 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We examine how liberalizing inheritance law can affect the diffusion of wealth beyond family dynasties. Exploiting a reform that reduced mandatory estate shares for children and surviving parents, we analyze testator responses in a unique dataset of 16,887 anonymous online wills. We find that greater testamentary freedom led testators to increase transfers primarily to spouses and life partners, but also to nonrelatives and charitable organizations. Our estimated ’marginal diffusion propensity’ reveals that, for each additional percentage point of freely disposable wealth, approximately one third was reallocated towards recipients outside the core family. Extrapolating this effect suggests that liberalization could result in additional annual extra-dynastic bequests of up to 0.8% of national income in countries with restrictive inheritance rules.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨了放宽继承法如何影响财富在家族王朝之外的扩散。利用一项减少子女及在世父母法定继承份额的改革，我们分析了一个包含16,887份匿名在线遗嘱的独特数据集中立遗嘱人的反应。我们发现，更大的遗嘱自由促使立遗嘱人主要增加对配偶及生活伴侣的转移，同时也向非亲属和慈善组织转移。我们估算的“边际扩散倾向”显示，每增加一个百分点的自由支配财富，大约有三分之一被重新分配至核心家庭之外的受益人。将此效应外推表明，在继承规则严格的国家，放宽继承法可能导致每年额外高达国民收入0.8%的跨王朝遗赠。

title: Link by consensus: Formation of community networks
title_zh: 共识联结：社区网络的形成
title_primary: 共识联结：社区网络的形成
title_secondary: Link by consensus: Formation of community networks
authors: Shahir Safi
official: 官方在线 2026-07-30 · 来源：RSS
abstract: In close-knit communities, relationships are often formed and severed through the consent of community members. Inspired by this fact, I consider network formation when individuals need the consent of at least a fraction 𝑝 of the population to form or sever links. First, I show that a small consent requirement ( 𝑝 = 1 / ( 𝑛 − 1 ) ) is sufficient to stabilize efficient networks in the classical connections model. Second, I establish that altering only one feature of the connections model — type of externalities (positive vs negative) or path-dependence (single vs multiple paths) — has little impact, whereas modifying both features simultaneously produces significant changes in outcomes. My analysis highlights the importance of understanding complementarities between different features of externalities in network formation.
abstract_zh: 在紧密联系的社群中，人际关系的建立与解除往往需经社群成员的共识。受此启发，我探讨了当个体需获得至少人口比例p的同意才能建立或解除联系时的网络形成问题。首先，我证明了一个较小的同意要求（p = 1 / ( n - 1 )）足以在经典连接模型中稳定高效网络。其次，我确认仅改变连接模型的一个特征——外部性类型（正或负）或路径依赖性（单路径或多路径）——影响甚微，而同时修改这两个特征则会导致结果显著变化。我的分析强调了理解网络形成中不同外部性特征间互补性的重要性。

title: Examining year-end spending surge and ratchet effect: Evidence from bunching estimation and zero-based budget reform in China
title_zh: 年末支出激增与棘轮效应研究：来自中国聚束估计与零基预算改革的证据
title_primary: 年末支出激增与棘轮效应研究：来自中国聚束估计与零基预算改革的证据
title_secondary: Examining year-end spending surge and ratchet effect: Evidence from bunching estimation and zero-based budget reform in China
authors: Jidong Li, Chen Yuan
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper investigates how the “ratchet effect” from the institutional linkage of current expenditures to future budget allocations drives excessive year-end government spending. Applying novel bunching estimation to 1.18 million Chinese procurement contracts (2015–2021), we quantify year-end excess spending, finding approximately 17.81 billion CNY in wasteful year-end spending annually. We show this rush manifests through two detrimental behaviors: regulatory evasion, which increases contract violations, and official discretion, which reduces the quality of suppliers. Exploiting China's Zero-Based Budgeting (ZBB) reform in a difference-in-differences framework, we find that decoupling budgets across years reduces year-end overspending by 15.8%. Critically, the reform works primarily by curbing official discretion, while having limited impact on regulatory evasion. Our findings disentangle the behavioral mechanisms of year-end spending and provide key insights for designing effective budget reforms.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了当前支出与未来预算分配的制度性关联所产生的“棘轮效应”如何驱动年末政府过度支出。通过将新颖的聚束估计方法应用于2015至2021年间118万份中国采购合同，我们量化了年末超额支出，发现每年约有178.1亿元人民币的浪费性年末支出。我们表明，这种突击花钱表现为两种有害行为：规避监管，导致合同违规增加；以及官员自由裁量权，降低了供应商质量。利用中国零基预算改革，在双重差分框架下，我们发现跨年度预算脱钩使年末超支减少了15.8%。关键在于，该改革主要通过抑制官员自由裁量权发挥作用，而对规避监管的影响有限。我们的研究厘清了年末支出的行为机制，为设计有效的预算改革提供了关键见解。

title: Low-Cost AI and the Value of Compute Scarcity: Evidence from the DeepSeek Shock
title_zh: 低成本人工智能与算力稀缺性的价值：来自DeepSeek冲击的证据
title_primary: 低成本人工智能与算力稀缺性的价值：来自DeepSeek冲击的证据
title_secondary: Low-Cost AI and the Value of Compute Scarcity: Evidence from the DeepSeek Shock
authors: Lingteng Zeng
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: We study whether the DeepSeek-R1 shock changed the market value of scarce AI compute. Using U.S. stock returns around January 27, 2025 and compute-supply exposure from pre-event 10-K filings, firms more exposed to supplying AI compute earned significantly lower abnormal returns. In the preferred specification, higher compute-supply exposure predicts a 2.37 percentage-point lower three-day cumulative abnormal return (CAR[-1,+1]). Results survive industry fixed effects, risk and financial controls, alternative benchmarks, placebo dates, and text-validation checks. The evidence suggests DeepSeek was priced as a shock to AI compute scarcity rents, not only a broad technology-sector shock.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了DeepSeek-R1冲击是否改变了稀缺AI算力的市场价值。利用2025年1月27日前后的美国股票回报率以及事件前10-K文件中披露的算力供应敞口，我们发现，更倾向于供应AI算力的公司在异常回报率上显著更低。在首选规格中，更高的算力供应敞口预示着三天累计异常回报率（CAR[-1,+1]）下降2.37个百分点。该结果在行业固定效应、风险与财务控制、替代基准、安慰剂日期以及文本验证检查中均保持稳健。证据表明，DeepSeek被定价为对AI算力稀缺性租金的冲击，而不仅仅是广泛的技术板块冲击。

title: Dollar erosion: The macroeconomic consequences of losing reserve currency status
title_zh: 美元侵蚀：失去储备货币地位的宏观经济后果
title_primary: 美元侵蚀：失去储备货币地位的宏观经济后果
title_secondary: Dollar erosion: The macroeconomic consequences of losing reserve currency status
authors: Zhengyang Jiang, Arvind Krishnamurthy, Hanno Lustig, Robert Richmond
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The dollar's role as the world's reserve currency has been blamed for an overvalued exchange rate that hollows out US manufacturing. This column quantifies what would happen if foreign investors stopped treating US safe assets as international liquidity. In a calibrated two-country model, the exchange-rate consequences are present but modest – a permanent real depreciation of roughly 9% – while the larger effects fall on US interest rates, which rise by around 90 basis points, and on national wealth, where the lost seigniorage is worth close to one year of GDP. The recent decline in convenience yields and foreign ownership of US public debt suggests the transition may already be under way.
abstract_zh: 美元作为全球储备货币的角色，被指责导致汇率高估，进而掏空了美国制造业。本文量化分析了如果外国投资者不再将美国安全资产视为国际流动性工具，将会发生什么。在一个经过校准的两国模型中，汇率影响确实存在但较为温和——实际汇率永久性贬值约9%——而更大的影响则体现在美国利率上，利率上升约90个基点，以及国民财富方面，损失的铸币税接近一年的GDP。近期便利收益率下降以及外国持有美国公共债务减少表明，这一转变可能已经开始。

title: DP51 From Survey to Sample: Labor Market Data for Interwar London
title_zh: 从调查到样本：两次世界大战间伦敦的劳动力市场数据
title_primary: 从调查到样本：两次世界大战间伦敦的劳动力市场数据
title_secondary: DP51 From Survey to Sample: Labor Market Data for Interwar London
authors: Barry Eichengreen, Susan Freiwald, David Chilosi, Giampaolo Lecce, Patrick Wallis 等
official: 官方在线 1985-02-01 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper describes a new microdata set which can be used to study the operation of the British labour market and the incidence of interwar unemployment. The data set is a sample of households drawn from the records of the New Survey of London Life and Labour, conducted in the years 1928-32 at the London School of Economics. We describe the problems which arose in the course of our efforts to extract from the archives a random sample of cases and the ways these problems were resolved. We indicate also the limitations of the original survey design and their implications for economic and historical investigations attempting to utilize these materials.
abstract_zh: 本文描述了一个可用于研究英国劳动力市场运作及两次世界大战期间失业发生率的新微观数据集。该数据集是从伦敦政治经济学院于1928-1932年间开展的《伦敦生活与劳动新调查》记录中抽取的家庭样本。我们阐述了在从档案中提取随机样本过程中遇到的问题及其解决方法，同时指出了原始调查设计的局限性，以及这些局限性对试图利用这些材料进行经济与历史研究的影响。

title: Air Pollution and Early Childhood Outcomes: Evidence from Georgia Childcare Providers
title_zh: 空气污染与儿童早期发展结果：来自佐治亚州儿童保育机构的证据
title_primary: 空气污染与儿童早期发展结果：来自佐治亚州儿童保育机构的证据
title_secondary: Air Pollution and Early Childhood Outcomes: Evidence from Georgia Childcare Providers
authors: Ghafarianghadim, Mahta, Heutel, Garth
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Many effects of pollution exposure on health and education outcomes of children have been identified, but little is known about education effects on preschool-aged children. We estimate the effect of particulate matter air pollution on preschool attendance using restricted administrative data from the state of Georgia. We use thermal inversions, weather phenomena that trap pollutants, as an instrumental variable for pollution. A one-unit increase in the county-week average ambient particulate pollution level decreases attendance by around 2 percentage points. Effects seem to be larger for racial minorities and for children with working parents.
abstract_zh: 已有研究证实污染暴露对儿童健康与教育成果的多重影响，但关于学龄前儿童教育影响的研究仍较为有限。本研究利用佐治亚州的受限行政数据，评估颗粒物空气污染对学前教育出勤率的影响。我们采用热逆温现象（一种滞留污染物的天气现象）作为污染的工具变量。数据显示，县级周均环境颗粒物污染水平每上升1个单位，学前教育出勤率将下降约2个百分点。该影响在少数族裔儿童及父母双职工家庭中更为显著。

title: Adoption Dynamics of Fungus‐Resistant Grapevine Varieties: A Real Options Approach
title_zh: 抗真菌葡萄品种的采用动态：一种实物期权方法
title_primary: 抗真菌葡萄品种的采用动态：一种实物期权方法
title_secondary: Adoption Dynamics of Fungus‐Resistant Grapevine Varieties: A Real Options Approach
authors: Eileen Ziehmann, Niklas Möhring, Robert Finger
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Viticulture is a key economic sector in Europe, but responsible for vast amounts of fungicide use. Fungus‐resistant grapevine varieties are less susceptible to fungal diseases, reducing fungicide use by up to 80%. However, their adoption remains limited, despite their economic and environmental advantages. We develop a bio‐economic simulation model with a real options investment perspective to analyze farmers’ decisions to adopt resistant varieties, accounting for different risk factors (e.g., production, market, policy). We apply the model to the case of Swiss viticulture. Results indicate that in the short‐term, adoption barriers persist for the majority of farmers, with replanting occurring only when favorable conditions are met, such as low discount rates, high disease pressure, and available price premia. Conversely, we find that in the long‐term, as vines reach replacement age, resistant varieties are favored over traditional ones. Our findings further indicate that increases in disease pressure, for example, due to climate change, are likely to accelerate the early adoption of fungus‐resistant varieties. We highlight potential avenues for improving current support for replanting in Switzerland, for example, through market access and information provision. By integrating risk and managerial flexibility into a dynamic, real options decision‐making framework, this study provides new insights for designing effective policies to promote sustainable pest management in viticulture.
abstract_zh: 葡萄栽培是欧洲重要的经济部门，但也是大量杀菌剂使用的来源。抗真菌葡萄品种对真菌病害的敏感性较低，可将杀菌剂使用量减少高达80%。然而，尽管具有经济和环境优势，其采用率仍然有限。我们构建了一个结合实物期权投资视角的生物经济模拟模型，用于分析农户采纳抗性品种的决策，并考虑了不同风险因素（如生产、市场、政策）。我们将该模型应用于瑞士葡萄栽培案例。结果表明，短期内，大多数农户仍面临采用障碍，只有在满足低贴现率、高病害压力和可获得溢价等有利条件时才会进行重新种植。相反，我们发现长期来看，当葡萄藤达到更新树龄时，抗性品种比传统品种更受青睐。我们的研究进一步表明，病害压力的增加（例如因气候变化所致）可能加速抗真菌品种的早期采用。我们指出了改善瑞士当前重新种植支持政策的潜在途径，例如通过市场准入和信息提供。通过将风险和管理灵活性纳入动态的实物期权决策框架，本研究为设计促进葡萄栽培可持续病虫害管理的有效政策提供了新见解。

title: The Uneven Impact of Generative Artificial Intelligence on Entrepreneurial Performance: Evidence from a Field Experiment in Kenya

title: 监管沙盒何以缓释银行系统性风险？——基于银行金融科技创新与监管的演化博弈分析

title_primary: 监管沙盒何以缓释银行系统性风险？——基于银行金融科技创新与监管的演化博弈分析
authors: 马亚明, 徐佳翔, 温博慧, 袁铭, 孟弋然
official: 官方发布 2026-07-05 · 来源：CNKI RSS
abstract: 金融监管如何促进金融科技创新去伪存真、平衡创新激励与风险防范，是我国推进金融高质量发展进程中亟待解决的难题之一，监管沙盒试验为破解这一难题提供了实践参考。本文通过构建银行与监管部门的演化博弈模型并进行仿真分析，进而以监管沙盒实施作为准自然实验，检验其对银行系统性风险的缓释效果。研究发现：监管沙盒对银行系统性风险具有缓释作用，其能够通过提升银行金融科技创新质量，实现对银行系统性风险的缓释。银行金融科技创新质量提升可通过提高银行效率与抑制机构关联来降低潜在系统性风险，监管沙盒则进一步强化了上述机制。具体表现为：一方面，通过增强创新质量对银行效率的驱动来提升风险抵御能力；另一方面，通过加强其对关联程度的抑制来弱化风险传染。本文研究为识别监管沙盒效能、揭示其风险缓释作用路径提供了理论支撑和实证证据，对完善金融科技创新监管框架、引导高质量金融科技创新具有参考价值。

title: Minimum wage and child health: Evidence from the 1966 Fair Labor Standards Act
title_zh: 最低工资与儿童健康：来自1966年《公平劳动标准法》的证据
title_primary: 最低工资与儿童健康：来自1966年《公平劳动标准法》的证据
title_secondary: Minimum wage and child health: Evidence from the 1966 Fair Labor Standards Act
authors: Kassahun Mamo Geleta
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-05 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: In the minimum wage literature, much of the focus has been on the effects of minimum wage changes on employment, wages, earnings of labour market participants, and income. However, through its influence on parents’ income, time allocation, and capacity for health investment, a change in minimum wage can also affect child health. In this study, I examine the effect of the minimum wage introduced by the 1966 Fair Labor Standards Act on child health. The study uses intergenerational survey data from US households in the Panel Study of Income Dynamics (PSID) and employs a difference-in-differences research design. The results show that the introduction of a minimum wage increases the likelihood of a healthy childhood. The effect is not homogeneous across states; it is stronger in states without prior minimum wage policies, where the Act represented a larger shock. The results further reveal significant gender heterogeneity, indicating that the health improvement effect of the minimum wage policy is substantially stronger for girls than for boys. The findings are robust to a range of additional validation exercises, including event-study specifications, spillover analyses, and placebo tests.
abstract_zh: 在最低工资文献中，研究重点多集中于最低工资变动对就业、工资、劳动力市场参与者收入及总体收入的影响。然而，最低工资变动通过影响父母的收入、时间分配及健康投资能力，也可能对儿童健康产生作用。本研究考察了1966年《公平劳动标准法》引入的最低工资制度对儿童健康的影响。研究采用美国收入动态追踪调查（PSID）中的跨代际家庭数据，并运用双重差分研究设计。结果表明，最低工资的引入提高了儿童拥有健康童年的可能性。该效应在各州间并非同质：在未实施过最低工资政策的州（该法案带来的冲击更大）中，效应更为显著。结果进一步揭示了显著的性别异质性，表明最低工资政策对女孩的健康改善效应明显强于男孩。上述发现在一系列额外验证测试中保持稳健，包括事件研究设定、溢出效应分析及安慰剂检验。

title: Recommendation power and competition
title_zh: 推荐力与竞争
title_primary: 推荐力与竞争
title_secondary: Recommendation power and competition
authors: Martin Peitz, Anton Sobolev
official: 官方在线 2026-06-24 · 来源：RSS
abstract: A firm may decide to make total-surplus-reducing purchase recommendations in response to consumer heterogeneity in an experience good setting with endogenous prices. First, we show under which conditions the firm chooses to make such biased recommendations in a monopoly setting. Second, we propose a duopoly model with differentiated products in which single-product firms compete in uniform prices and recommendation policies. We establish when and why both firms bias their recommendations. This bias can disappear when the market becomes less competitive, one firm exits, or both firms merge.
abstract_zh: 在体验品市场中，面对内生价格与消费者异质性，企业可能选择做出降低总剩余的购买推荐。首先，我们展示了在垄断情境下，企业选择做出此类有偏推荐的条件。其次，我们提出一个差异化产品的双寡头模型，其中单一产品企业在统一定价和推荐策略下竞争。我们确定了双方企业何时以及为何会偏向其推荐。当市场竞争减弱、一家企业退出或两家企业合并时，这种偏差可能消失。

title: Yet another estimate of the consequences of the bank levy for the credit market in Poland
title_zh: 银行税对波兰信贷市场影响的又一估计
title_primary: 银行税对波兰信贷市场影响的又一估计
title_secondary: Yet another estimate of the consequences of the bank levy for the credit market in Poland
authors: Mariusz Kapuściński
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: The effects of the bank levy in Poland on the broadly defined credit market (including on loan rates and volumes) appear to be well documented, with the use of the standard difference-in-differences (DID) method. However, as, for example, Borusyak et al. (2024) note, in a setting with staggered treatment (as in the case of the bank levy in Poland), and different effects of the treatment in time and between cross-sections, the method might provide biased estimates. None of the studies to date used the heterogenous DID method that addresses this drawback. In this research note I use the heterogenous DID method to estimate the consequences of the bank levy. I also discuss other methodological choices. Among other things, I find that the bank levy has lowered deposit rates, raised rates on loans for house purchases, and changed the composition and the level of bank assets. However, I find no longer-term crowding out of credit by government bond securities (while the latter did increase, the former did not increase) or effects on bank profitability. The use of a more advised method did not lead to results in stark contrast with the earlier literature applying methods for causal inference.
abstract_zh: 波兰银行税对广义信贷市场（包括贷款利率和规模）的影响已有充分文献记载，且普遍采用标准双重差分法（DID）进行分析。然而，正如Borusyak等人（2024）所指出的，在交错处理情境下（如波兰银行税案例），若处理效应在时间维度与截面维度存在异质性，该方法可能产生有偏估计。现有研究均未采用能解决此缺陷的异质性双重差分法。本研究采用异质性双重差分法评估银行税的经济后果，并探讨其他方法论选择。研究发现：银行税降低了存款利率，提高了购房贷款利率，并改变了银行资产的构成与规模。但未发现政府债券对信贷存在长期挤出效应（尽管债券规模上升，信贷规模并未下降），也未发现银行税对盈利能力产生显著影响。采用更优方法所得结论与早期运用因果推断方法的研究并无显著差异。

title: Buyer's Hidden Search With Continuous Intensity: The Seller‐Optimal Mechanism and a Perverse Effect
title_zh: 连续强度下的买方隐藏搜索：卖方最优机制与一种反常效应
title_primary: 连续强度下的买方隐藏搜索：卖方最优机制与一种反常效应
title_secondary: Buyer's Hidden Search With Continuous Intensity: The Seller‐Optimal Mechanism and a Perverse Effect
authors: Dongri Liu, Jingfeng Lu
official: 官方在线 2026-06-19 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We adopt a dynamic mechanism design approach to study how a revenue‐maximizing seller should sell an indivisible object when a buyer with a private value can search for an outside option with continuous‐intensity choices. We find that lowering the buyer's search cost definitely reduces the seller's revenue when the buyer's search decision is binary, as in Armstrong and Zhou (2016). In contrast, with continuous search intensity, a counterintuitive effect may arise: lowering the buyer's search cost function can, under mild conditions, actually increase the seller's revenue.
abstract_zh: 我们采用动态机制设计方法，研究当具有私人价值的买方能够通过连续强度选择搜索外部选项时，追求收益最大化的卖方应如何销售不可分割商品。研究发现，当买方搜索决策为二元选择时（如Armstrong与Zhou 2016年所述），降低买方搜索成本必然减少卖方收益。然而在连续搜索强度下，可能产生反直觉效应：在温和条件下，降低买方搜索成本函数反而可能增加卖方收益。

title: Headwind in sight? Wind turbine visibility spillovers and support for renewable energy policy
title_zh: 眼前逆风？风力涡轮机可见性溢出效应对可再生能源政策支持的影响
title_primary: 眼前逆风？风力涡轮机可见性溢出效应对可再生能源政策支持的影响
title_secondary: Headwind in sight? Wind turbine visibility spillovers and support for renewable energy policy
authors: Vincent F. Stegmaier, Melanie Krause
source: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
official: 官方在线 2026-06-18 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Wind power expansion is a central environmental policy objective, yet it may entail aesthetic disamenities for nearby residents. Turbine visibility often transcends administrative borders, whereas political and economic processes remain more localized. We exploit this spatial asymmetry to identify the impact of cross-jurisdictional visual exposure on support for climate mitigation policies, proxied by pro-renewable voting in Germany between 1998 and 2021. We find no electoral backlash in earlier periods, but significant declines in support in more recent elections. These dynamics are consistent with shifts in debates over wind energy expansion and the growing salience of landscape concerns, with stronger effects in rural areas and in places with organized resistance, while localized economic benefits may partly offset adverse attitudes.
abstract_zh: 风电扩张是一项核心的环境政策目标，然而它可能对邻近居民造成美学上的不便。风机可见性往往超越行政边界，而政治和经济过程则更为地方化。我们利用这种空间不对称性，来识别跨辖区视觉暴露对气候减缓政策支持度的影响，以1998年至2021年间德国支持可再生能源的投票作为代理指标。我们发现早期阶段并未出现选举反弹，但在近期的选举中支持度显著下降。这些动态与关于风电扩张辩论的转变及景观关注日益凸显的趋势相吻合，且在乡村地区及存在有组织抵抗的地方影响更为强烈，而地方经济利益可能部分抵消不利态度。

title: The politics of land in Israel’s solar transition: Top-down and bottom-up governance
title_zh: 以色列太阳能转型中的土地政治：自上而下与自下而上的治理
title_primary: 以色列太阳能转型中的土地政治：自上而下与自下而上的治理
title_secondary: The politics of land in Israel’s solar transition: Top-down and bottom-up governance
authors: Avri Eitan, Shira Bukchin-Peles
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-18 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The expansion of solar energy has brought land to the center of energy policy debates, yet the governance processes that determine how land is allocated, contested, and transformed remain insufficiently understood. This article examines how solar deployment reshapes land-use governance through the interaction between top-down state authority and bottom-up local claims across open landscapes, built environments, and productive agricultural lands. Israel provides a revealing setting, as land scarcity and a centralised land regime heighten the stakes of solar siting and make governance tensions visible. Drawing on a qualitative case study based on regulatory documents, governmental protocols, stakeholder materials, field visits, and 26 semi-structured interviews, the analysis shows that solar siting generates distinct temporal, spatial, and distributive effects. National authorities accelerate deployment and set spatial priorities that treat territories as readily available for development. Municipalities, communities, and landholders respond by mobilizing ecological knowledge, asserting community rights, and advancing alternative visions of land value. These encounters shape which landscapes host solar infrastructure, which land uses are displaced or preserved, and how transition benefits and burdens are distributed. Although grounded in Israel, these mechanisms extend more broadly. Across settings, solar expansion operates less as a uniform national strategy than as a negotiated reconfiguration of territorial authority, land politics, and spatial meaning. The findings demonstrate that the energy transition is also a land-use transition. For land-use policy, this underscores the need for governance arrangements that balance national goals with place-based priorities and enable renewable energy development to proceed in legitimate and spatially just ways.
abstract_zh: 太阳能扩张已将土地置于能源政策辩论的核心，然而决定土地如何被分配、争夺和改造的治理过程仍未得到充分理解。本文考察太阳能部署如何通过自上而下的国家权威与自下而上的地方诉求在开阔景观、建成环境和生产性农业用地中的互动，重塑土地利用治理。以色列提供了一个具有揭示性的研究场景，因为土地稀缺和集中化的土地制度提高了太阳能选址的利害关系，使治理张力清晰可见。基于对监管文件、政府议定书、利益相关者材料、实地考察以及26次半结构化访谈的定性案例研究，分析表明太阳能选址产生了不同的时间、空间和分配效应。国家主管部门加速部署并设定空间优先次序，将领土视为可随时用于开发。市政当局、社区和土地所有者则通过调动生态知识、主张社区权利以及提出土地价值的替代愿景来回应。这些交锋塑造了哪些景观承载太阳能基础设施、哪些土地利用被取代或保留，以及转型收益与负担如何分配。尽管以以色列为背景，这些机制具有更广泛的适用性。在不同情境下，太阳能扩张与其说是一项统一的国家战略，不如说是一种对领土权威、土地政治和空间意义的协商性重构。研究结果表明，能源转型同时也是土地利用转型。对土地利用政策而言，这凸显了治理安排的必要性，即在国家目标与地方优先事项之间取得平衡，并使可再生能源开发以合法且空间公正的方式推进。

title: Pre-Booked Vaccination Appointments as a Nudge: Evidence from a Nationwide Intervention
title_zh: 预约定点疫苗接种作为一种助推手段：来自全国性干预的证据
title_primary: 预约定点疫苗接种作为一种助推手段：来自全国性干预的证据
title_secondary: Pre-Booked Vaccination Appointments as a Nudge: Evidence from a Nationwide Intervention
authors: Jakob Moeller, Martin Halla, Tobias Thomas
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We study the effect of pre-booked COVID-19 vaccination appointments using a nationwide campaign in Austria. Leveraging administrative microdata on more than 450000 initially unvaccinated adults, we exploit cross-state variation in program participation and staggered appointment timing in a difference-in-differences design. Pre-booked appointments increase vaccination on the appointment day by 0.8 percentage points (8 per 1000), with no evidence of intertemporal substitution. Effects are larger for socio-economically disadvantaged individuals and substantially weaker in areas with stronger vaccine skepticism. The findings suggest that behavioral interventions are effective when low uptake reflects frictions, but have limited impact when driven by entrenched skepticism.
abstract_zh: 我们利用奥地利全国性疫苗接种活动，研究了预先预约新冠疫苗接种的效果。基于超过45万名初始未接种成年人的行政微观数据，我们采用双重差分法，利用各州在项目参与率及预约时间安排上的差异。预先预约使接种当日的疫苗接种率提高了0.8个百分点（每千人增加8人），且未发现跨期替代效应。该效应在社会经济弱势群体中更为显著，而在疫苗怀疑论较强的地区则明显减弱。研究结果表明，当低接种率源于摩擦性障碍时，行为干预措施有效；但当其源于根深蒂固的怀疑态度时，干预效果有限。

title: The Impact of Supply and Demand Changes on Non‐Real‐Estate Agricultural Loans
title_zh: 供需变化对非房地产农业贷款的影响
title_primary: 供需变化对非房地产农业贷款的影响
title_secondary: The Impact of Supply and Demand Changes on Non‐Real‐Estate Agricultural Loans
authors: Francisco Scott, Todd H. Kuethe, Ty Kreitman, David Oppedahl
official: 官方在线 2026-06-04 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study examines the degree to which changes in non‐real‐estate agricultural loans at commercial banks are driven by changes in supply or demand. Our identification strategy exploits information provided by agricultural lending surveys conducted by three Federal Reserve Banks: Chicago, Kansas City, and Minneapolis. Building on recent studies of loan officer opinion surveys, we estimate the changes in agricultural loan supply and demand using an unbalanced panel of 1028 banks across the 2002–2021 period. The survey responses provide instruments for supply and demand changes to examine fluctuations in bank‐level agricultural loan volumes obtained from Federal Financial Institutions Examinations Council quarterly “call reports.” We find that changes in the volume of non‐real‐estate farm loans at commercial banks are principally driven by changes in excess loan demand. These findings support a careful approach for policies aimed at boosting supply of agricultural credit. JEL Classification: Q14, G21, Q00
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了商业银行非房地产农业贷款变动在多大程度上由供给或需求变化所驱动。我们的识别策略利用了芝加哥、堪萨斯城和明尼阿波利斯三家联邦储备银行开展的农业贷款调查所提供的信息。基于近期对贷款官员意见调查的研究，我们使用2002年至2021年间1028家银行的不平衡面板数据，估算了农业贷款供给与需求的变化。调查回应为供给与需求变化提供了工具变量，用以考察从联邦金融机构审查委员会季度“呼叫报告”中获取的银行层面农业贷款额的波动。我们发现，商业银行非房地产农场贷款额的变动主要由超额贷款需求的变化所驱动。这些发现为旨在增加农业信贷供给的政策提供了审慎的制定依据。JEL分类：Q14, G21, Q00

title: A quantitative urban model for transport appraisal
title_zh: 交通评估的定量城市模型
title_primary: 交通评估的定量城市模型
title_secondary: A quantitative urban model for transport appraisal
authors: Daniel Hörcher, Daniel J. Graham
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-04 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Understanding the spatial economic impacts of large-scale transport infrastructure projects is vital for promoting ecient resource allocation in modern economies. However, the current practice of economic evaluation in transport policy is largely conned to partial equilibrium models, which focus solely on transport markets in isolation, ignoring the transformative impact of large-scale interventions. In this paper, we build upon the methodological principles of quantitative spatial economics, an emerging eld within the spatial economics literature, to design an appraisal method that captures the interactions between transport supply and the labour, production and real estate markets. Our model features travel time valuations that are micro-founded through an explicit leisure-labour trade-o, making them unique to each residence-workplace pair. The model is invertible and suitable for the theoretically and geographically coherent causal estimation of the dispersion of idiosyncratic location choice preferences and the strength and distance decay of agglomeration forces.
abstract_zh: 理解大型交通基础设施项目的空间经济影响，对于促进现代经济中资源的高效配置至关重要。然而，当前交通政策中的经济评估实践大多局限于局部均衡模型，这些模型仅孤立地关注交通市场，忽视了大规模干预措施的变革性影响。本文基于定量空间经济学的方法论原则——这一空间经济学文献中的新兴领域，设计了一种评估方法，用以捕捉交通供给与劳动力、生产及房地产市场之间的相互作用。我们的模型通过明确的休闲-劳动权衡，为出行时间价值提供了微观基础，使其对每个居住-工作地点组合具有独特性。该模型可逆，适用于对个体区位选择偏好离散度的异质性以及集聚力的强度与距离衰减效应进行理论上和地理上连贯的因果估计。

title: The promotion club
title_zh: 推广俱乐部
title_primary: 推广俱乐部
title_secondary: The promotion club
authors: Shuo Chen, Xinyu Fan, Zhitao Zhu
official: 官方在线 2026-06-03 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We theoretically and empirically explore club-based promotions in hierarchical organizations. A game-theoretic model shows that strategic ambiguity in promotions—more specifically, an incentive scheme in which only top performers who pass a relative-performance threshold are eligible for promotions—may outperform single-prize tournaments in terms of both effort and leaders’ flexibility over personnel. Selection among threshold passers is independent of their performance and the discretionary choice of the leaders. Analysis of local officials’ career records in hierarchical governments in China over a 16-year period validates the existence of club-based patterns in governmental promotions. Thresholds are more lenient for higher-ranked positions and when relative performance is harder to measure.
abstract_zh: 我们从理论与实证两个维度探讨了层级组织中的俱乐部式晋升机制。一个博弈论模型表明，晋升中的策略性模糊——具体而言，即一种激励方案，其中只有超过相对绩效门槛的顶尖表现者才有资格获得晋升——在努力程度和领导者对人事安排的灵活性方面，可能优于单一奖项竞赛。门槛通过者的选拔与其表现无关，且不受领导者的自由裁量影响。对中国层级政府中地方官员16年职业生涯记录的分析，验证了政府晋升中俱乐部式模式的存在。门槛对于更高层级的职位以及相对绩效难以衡量时更为宽松。

title: Farmers' Beliefs About Climate Action: Evidence From an Information Experiment
title_zh: 农民对气候行动的信念：来自信息实验的证据
title_primary: 农民对气候行动的信念：来自信息实验的证据
title_secondary: Farmers' Beliefs About Climate Action: Evidence From an Information Experiment
authors: Felipe Aguiar‐Noury, Doris Läpple, Cathal Buckley
official: 官方在线 2026-05-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: ABSTRACT Farmers' adoption of climate change mitigation practices is crucial for reducing greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions from food production. One major source of these emissions is chemical fertilizer application. Introducing clover into grassland can mitigate emissions by reducing the need for chemical fertilizers. In this study, we conduct an information experiment with over 300 Irish dairy farmers to examine how information impacts their beliefs about clover adoption, and how this in turn influences subsequent intentions. Methodologically, we contribute to the literature by combining qualitative (i.e., open‐ended questions) and quantitative (i.e., point estimates) belief elicitation measures in our experimental design. This approach provides more detailed insights into farmers' beliefs, as it captures top‐of‐mind concerns without priming responses. Our qualitative belief elicitation reveals that after exposure to the information treatments, while most farmers did not change their opinions, some shifted from concerns such as ‘ bloat ’ and ‘ difficult ’ to terms like ‘ reduction ’ and ‘ possible ’. Our quantitative measures show that farmers underestimated clover's potential to reduce chemical fertilizer use. This finding is key for policymakers, as similar underestimations may apply to other GHG mitigation practices. Importantly, we provide causal evidence that information could reduce misperceptions. This highlights the need for strategies that positively shift beliefs to encourage more widespread uptake of climate change mitigation practices. Nonetheless, there was no meaningful impact of the updated beliefs on intentions, which underlines the complexity of adoption decisions.
abstract_zh: 摘要 农民采纳气候变化减缓措施对于减少粮食生产中的温室气体排放至关重要。化学肥料施用是这些排放的主要来源之一。在草地中引入三叶草可通过减少化学肥料需求来减缓排放。本研究通过对300多名爱尔兰奶牛农民进行信息实验，考察信息如何影响他们对三叶草采纳的信念，以及这种信念变化如何进一步影响后续意图。在方法论上，我们通过将定性（即开放式问题）和定量（即点估计）信念引出措施结合到实验设计中，为文献做出贡献。这种方法能更细致地洞察农民的信念，因为它捕捉了首要关注点而不引导回答。我们的定性信念引出显示，在接触信息处理后，尽管大多数农民未改变观点，但部分人从“膨胀”和“困难”等担忧转向“减少”和“可能”等表述。定量测量显示，农民低估了三叶草减少化学肥料使用的潜力。这一发现对政策制定者至关重要，因为类似的低估可能适用于其他温室气体减缓措施。重要的是，我们提供了因果证据表明信息可以减少误解。这凸显了采取策略积极转变信念以促进更广泛采纳气候变化减缓措施的必要性。尽管如此，更新后的信念对意图没有显著影响，这强调了采纳决策的复杂性。

title: The Intergenerational Impact of Birth-Control Policies on Fertility: The Role of Norms
title_zh: 生育控制政策的代际影响：规范的作用
title_primary: 生育控制政策的代际影响：规范的作用
title_secondary: The Intergenerational Impact of Birth-Control Policies on Fertility: The Role of Norms
authors: Rufei Guo, Lin Lin, Junjian Yi, Hanyu Zhu
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-18 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study the intergenerational impact of birth-control policies on fertility and examine whether and how these policies reduce fertility, even after their abolition. We develop a model that integrates the endogenous evolution of fertility norms. Birth-control policies, through the reduction of mothers’ fertility, establish new norms that shape the fertility decisions of subsequent generations. Consequently, daughters’ fertility is lower due to these new norms, even when the policies are no longer in force. To test the model’s implications, we leverage a quasi-experimental setting provided by China’s One-Child Policy, which was implemented in a staggered manner starting in 1979 and gradually phased out beginning in 2014. Based on the recently released 2020 population census, our results reveal that the policy has an impact on reducing fertility and affects generations no longer subject to its regulations. This study is the first to provide causal evidence of birth-control policies from an intergenerational perspective and highlights the role of norms in shaping fertility outcomes.
abstract_zh: 本文研究生育控制政策对生育率的代际影响，并探讨这些政策在废除后是否以及如何持续降低生育率。我们构建了一个融合生育规范内生演化的模型。生育控制政策通过降低母亲的生育率，建立了影响后代生育决策的新规范。因此，即使政策不再实施，女儿这一代的生育率也会因这些新规范而降低。为检验模型推论，我们利用中国独生子女政策提供的准实验环境——该政策自1979年起分阶段实施，并于2014年开始逐步退出。基于最新公布的2020年人口普查数据，研究结果表明，该政策不仅降低了生育率，还影响了不再受其约束的世代。本研究首次从代际视角为生育控制政策提供了因果证据，并揭示了规范在塑造生育结果中的关键作用。

title: Harnessing Deductions to Increase Tax Compliance and Formalization
title_zh: 利用扣除额提高税收合规性与正规化
title_primary: 利用扣除额提高税收合规性与正规化
title_secondary: Harnessing Deductions to Increase Tax Compliance and Formalization
authors: Albrecht Bohne, Jan Sebastian Nimczik
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We evaluate a tax reform in Ecuador that introduced generous deductions from personal income taxes (PIT), encouraging consumers to request receipts. The reform addresses tax evasion by targeting small self-employed businesses that mainly sell goods or services not subject to value-added taxes (VAT) but that often evade income taxes. Exploiting plausibly exogenous variation in receipt demand due to the distribution of taxpayers across regions and professions, we find significant increases in reported profits among self-employed businesses exposed to the reform. We document spillover effects on VAT. Our net-revenue impact analysis suggests the additional tax payments outweigh the foregone tax revenue. (JEL H24, H25, H26, J23, K34, O17)
abstract_zh: 我们评估了厄瓜多尔的一项税制改革，该改革引入了慷慨的个人所得税（PIT）扣除项，鼓励消费者索取收据。这项改革通过针对主要销售不征收增值税（VAT）的商品或服务、但常逃避所得税的小型个体经营企业，来应对逃税问题。利用纳税人跨地区和职业分布带来的收据需求外生性变化，我们发现受改革影响的个体经营企业报告利润显著增加。我们记录了改革对增值税的溢出效应。净收入影响分析表明，额外税收收入超过了放弃的税收收入。（JEL H24, H25, H26, J23, K34, O17）

title: Time pressure reduces financial bubbles: evidence from a forecasting experiment
title_zh: 时间压力减少金融泡沫：来自预测实验的证据
title_primary: 时间压力减少金融泡沫：来自预测实验的证据
title_secondary: Time pressure reduces financial bubbles: evidence from a forecasting experiment
authors: Anufriev, Mikhail, Neunhoeffer, Frieder, Tuinstra 等
official: 官方在线 2026-03-27 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We investigate whether time pressure exacerbates or mitigates bubbles in laboratory experiments. We find that under high time pressure price volatility is lower and market prices are closer to their fundamental value. This is due to participants using simpler adaptive forecasting strategies, instead of the self-reinforcing extrapolative expectations that they use under low time pressure, and which are conducive to the emergence of bubbles. In addition, by substantially increasing the number of decision periods in our experiment, we find that in the long run prices tend to converge to their fundamental value, also in the absence of time pressure.
abstract_zh: 我们通过实验室实验探究时间压力是加剧还是缓解泡沫现象。研究发现，在高时间压力下，价格波动性更低，市场价格更接近其基础价值。这是因为参与者采用了更简单的适应性预测策略，而非低时间压力下使用的自我强化外推预期——后者正是导致泡沫产生的因素。此外，通过大幅增加实验中的决策周期数，我们发现长期来看，即使没有时间压力，价格也趋于收敛至基础价值。

title: Is acquisition‐related foreign direct investment during an economic crisis detrimental for domestic innovation?
title_zh: 经济危机期间与收购相关的外国直接投资是否对国内创新有害？
title_primary: 经济危机期间与收购相关的外国直接投资是否对国内创新有害？
title_secondary: Is acquisition‐related foreign direct investment during an economic crisis detrimental for domestic innovation?
authors: María García‐Vega, Apoorva Gupta, Richard Kneller
official: 官方在线 2026-02-21 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We study how acquisition-related foreign direct investment during economic crises affects R&D investments and the direction of innovation of target firms, compared with acquisitions made during periods of strong economic growth. Using a panel of Spanish firms, we find that foreign multinationals cherry-pick the best domestic firms, irrespective of the timing of acquisition. Using matching and difference-in-differences regressions, we find that firms acquired during economic crises experience smaller declines in R&D than those acquired during boom periods. Our results are consistent with the opportunity cost theory of R&D over the business cycle: during recessions, the relative cost of R&D falls, incentivizing innovation, particularly in new product development. However, only firms with sufficient access to finance can capitalize on these conditions. Our results suggest that acquisitions can ease financial constraints at a critical time, enabling target firms to sustain or redirect innovation efforts when incentives are most favorable.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了经济危机期间与并购相关的外国直接投资如何影响目标企业的研发投资及创新方向，并与经济强劲增长期间的并购进行比较。利用西班牙企业面板数据，我们发现外国跨国公司无论并购时机如何，都会挑选国内最优企业。通过匹配和双重差分回归，我们发现经济危机期间被收购的企业，其研发下降幅度小于繁荣期被收购的企业。我们的结果与研发机会成本理论在经济周期中的表现一致：衰退期间，研发的相对成本下降，激励创新，尤其是在新产品开发方面。然而，只有具备充足融资渠道的企业才能利用这些条件。我们的结果表明，并购可以在关键时刻缓解融资约束，使目标企业在激励最有利时维持或调整创新努力。

title: Deviance Information Criterion for Bayesian model selection: Theoretical justification and applications
title_zh: 贝叶斯模型选择的偏差信息准则：理论依据与应用
title_primary: 贝叶斯模型选择的偏差信息准则：理论依据与应用
title_secondary: Deviance Information Criterion for Bayesian model selection: Theoretical justification and applications
authors: Yong Li, Sushanta K. Mallick, Nianling Wang, Jun Yu, Tao Zeng
official: 官方在线 2025-03-17 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper provides a theoretical justification for the Deviance Information Criterion (DIC) as a Bayesian model selection tool using MCMC output. Unlike Akaike Information Criterion (AIC) and Bayesian Information Criterion (BIC), which balance model adequacy against complexity without considering prior information, DIC incorporates priors into this trade-off. The contributions of this paper are two-fold. First, it demonstrates that when a plug-in predictive distribution — obtained by substituting parameter values with their optimal estimates to yield the plug-in estimated sampling distribution — is used under a set of regularity conditions, the DIC serves as an asymptotically unbiased estimator of the expected Kullback–Leibler divergence between the data-generating process and the plug-in predictive distribution. Second, it develops higher-order expansions for DIC and the effective number of parameters, highlighting the effect of the priors. We employ DIC to compare discrete-choice models, stochastic frontier models, and copula models in three empirical applications; the results align with theoretical expectations, showing the utility of DIC as a versatile tool outperforming the traditional model selection criteria. It is found that the logit model is better than the probit model for investigating the marginal effects of parents’ education on children’s completion of high school. Additionally, the stochastic frontier model with an exponential distribution better fits electricity utility data than the normal distribution. Finally, the chosen copula models for S&P index returns exhibit heavy tails and strong tail dependence. By modelling the effect of priors through higher order expansions, we also find the above empirical models outperforming their benchmark counterparts in terms of predictive accuracy.
abstract_zh: 本文为偏差信息准则（DIC）作为基于MCMC输出的贝叶斯模型选择工具提供了理论依据。与赤池信息准则（AIC）和贝叶斯信息准则（BIC）不同，后者在平衡模型拟合度与复杂度时未考虑先验信息，而DIC则将先验纳入这一权衡之中。本文的贡献有两方面。首先，它证明了在一定的正则条件下，当使用插件预测分布——即通过将参数值替换为其最优估计以得到插件估计的抽样分布——时，DIC可作为数据生成过程与插件预测分布之间期望Kullback–Leibler散度的渐近无偏估计量。其次，本文发展了DIC和有效参数数目的高阶展开式，突显了先验的影响。我们在三个实证应用中采用DIC比较离散选择模型、随机前沿模型和copula模型；结果与理论预期一致，展示了DIC作为一种多功能工具优于传统模型选择准则的实用性。研究发现，在考察父母教育对子女完成高中教育的边际效应时，logit模型优于probit模型。此外，具有指数分布的随机前沿模型比正态分布更好地拟合了电力公用事业数据。最后，针对S&P指数收益所选的copula模型表现出重尾和强尾部依赖性。通过高阶展开对先验效应进行建模，我们还发现上述实证模型在预测准确性方面优于其基准对应模型。
